hooks.command:
python3 -I -B -c 'from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
cwd = Path.cwd()
root = next((p for p in (cwd, *cwd.parents) if (p / ".git").exists()), None)
if root is not None and (root / ".codex/hooks.json").is_file():
    script = root / "scripts/codex_hooks/check_changes.py"
    source = b""
    if script.resolve() == script and script.is_file():
        with script.open("rb") as stream:
            source = stream.read(32768)
    if sha256(source.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == "ea73d6246ca76ab36245076da4574ad228d85620875d56c86c8ffe65fc7a1074":
        exec(compile(source, str(script), "exec"), {"__name__": "__main__", "__file__": str(script)})
    else:
        print("{\"systemMessage\":\"ERROR Stop: project hook script unavailable or changed.\"}")'
